articles.title: Cronos halts blockchain after $75 million lending exploit hits lending app Tectonic
articles.snippet: An attacker allegedly pushed Tectonic’s thinly traded TONIC token up 100-fold, used it as collateral to borrow real assets and left most funds stranded when Cronos validators paused the network.

articles.title: From Hawala to Swift: Inside the 1,000-year battle to move money safely
articles.snippet: Finance has spent centuries decoupling wealth from physical transport, but constantly erasing friction creates vectors for increasingly high-tech exploits.

articles.title: A $1.1 million crypto card hack crashed a neobank's token 49%
articles.snippet: The exploit caused the neobank's AVICI token to drop 49% from a 24-hour high, hitting a record low before paring some of the losses.

articles.title: Cronos halts network after Tectonic exploit involving estimated $75M
articles.snippet: Crypto.com CEO Kris Marszalek said the company’s app and exchange were unaffected by the Tectonic breach and continued operating normally.

articles.title: Crypto.com's Cronos Halts Entire Blockchain After $75M Tectonic Exploit
articles.snippet: Some $6 million reached Ethereum before validators froze the chain, stranding the rest on a network that still is not producing blocks.
